clp.label: EU harmonised classification (CLP Annex VI, ATP23, Delegated Regulation (EU) 2025/1222)
clp.authority: Binding EU regulation: classification and labelling are mandatory for substances and mixtures; harmonised entries adopted by Commission delegated acts after ECHA RAC opinions.

p65.label: California Proposition 65 list, developmental toxicants
p65.authority: Binding Californian law: warnings required before exposure; the list is revised at least once a year by OEHHA.

ema.label: EMA pregnancy prevention programmes and contraindications
ema.authority: Binding in the EU through marketing authorisations and referral decisions; the medicines stay authorised but with conditions.

who.label: WHO fact sheet on congenital disorders
who.authority: Guidance, not binding; WHO keeps no list of teratogens.

efsa.label: European Food Safety Authority, health-based guidance values
efsa.authority: EU agency for risk assessment in the food chain. EFSA derives the intake considered tolerable and names the effect it rests on; it does not classify substances as teratogens, and its remit stops at food and feed.

nite.label: Japan: GHS classification by the National Institute of Technology and Evaluation (NITE)
nite.via: Read through PubChem (US National Library of Medicine), which republishes the classifications.
nite.authority: Classification made for the Japanese government to implement GHS labelling and safety-data-sheet duties under the Industrial Safety and Health Act and the PRTR Law. Each result names the ministry and the fiscal year. It corroborates a classification; it does not set an entry's level on this page, because a GHS hazard code does not separate category 1A from 1B.

eu-ppp.label: EU Pesticides Database: approval of active substances
eu-ppp.authority: European Commission, DG SANTE. Approval or refusal of a pesticide active substance under Regulation 1107/2009, by implementing regulation.

reach-xvii.label: REACH Annex XVII entry 30: reproductive toxicants not to be supplied to the public
reach-xvii.authority: Binding EU regulation. Appendices 5 and 6 name the category 1A and 1B reproductive toxicants that may not be placed on the market for supply to the general public.

reach-xiv.label: REACH Annex XIV: the authorisation list
reach-xiv.authority: Binding EU regulation. After the sunset date the substance may not be used or placed on the market at all unless the Commission grants an authorisation for a named use.

stockholm.label: Stockholm Convention on Persistent Organic Pollutants
stockholm.authority: Treaty binding its parties: Annex A eliminates production and use, Annex B restricts it to accepted purposes.

rotterdam.label: Rotterdam Convention: national bans and severe restrictions
rotterdam.authority: Decisions taken by national authorities and notified to the convention. A notification records what one country decided, not a global status.

cosmetics.label: Regulation 1223/2009: substances prohibited or restricted in cosmetic products
cosmetics.authority: Binding EU regulation. Annex II lists the substances that may not be used in a cosmetic product at all; Annex III lists those allowed only within the stated restrictions. Read from the consolidated regulation, because the Commission's CosIng database publishes no usable interface.

fda-registry.label: FDA list of pregnancy exposure registries
fda-registry.authority: A public list kept by the US Food and Drug Administration. Registries are listed by the FDA at the request of their sponsor or investigator. The FDA states that it does not endorse any registry and is not responsible for the content of the registries listed.

pubmed.label: PubMed: published literature on the substance and harm to the unborn child
pubmed.authority: One search per substance: the substance, by CAS registry number where the register holds one and by name in title or abstract, combined with the MeSH and title terms for harm to the unborn child.

entis.label: ENTIS expert list of known human structural teratogens
entis.citation: Bluett-Duncan M et al. A Scoping Review of Human Teratogens and Their Impact on the Developing Brain. Birth Defects Res. 2025;117(9):e2497
entis.authority: Experts of the European Network of Teratology Information Services, the services families and doctors consult about exposures in pregnancy. The list names the medicines they identify as known human structural teratogens.

entries.name: Acenocoumarol

sources.label: ENTIS expert list of known human structural teratogens
sources.note: Acenocoumarol is on the list of medicines that ENTIS experts identify as known human structural teratogens (Bluett-Duncan M et al. A Scoping Review of Human Teratogens and Their Impact on the Developing Brain. Birth Defects Res. 2025;117(9):e2497).

entries.exposure_why: It is taken as a medicine, and treatment is how a pregnancy meets it.

window.text: Malformations were described mostly after exposure between 6 and 9 weeks of pregnancy, counted from the first day of the last period (weeks of amenorrhoea).
window.quote: un syndrome malformatif a été décrit dans environ 4 % à 7 % des grossesses exposées le plus souvent entre 6 et 9 semaines d'aménorrhée.
window.source_label: ANSM, Résumé des Caractéristiques du Produit, SINTROM 4 mg (acénocoumarol), section 4.6, updated 20/06/2025

dose.text: A systematic review cites registry data that did not show reduced foetal loss with low first-trimester doses of vitamin K antagonists, low meaning 2 mg a day or less for acenocoumarol.
dose.quote: recent data from the Registry of Pregnancy and Cardiac disease (ROPAC) registry did not demonstrate reduced foetal loss with the use of low first-trimester doses of VKAs [warfarin ≤5 mg/day, acenocoumarol ≤2 mg/day or phenprocoumon ≤3 mg/day)]
dose.source_label: D'Souza et al., Anticoagulation for pregnant women with mechanical heart valves: a systematic review and meta-analysis, Eur Heart J 2017;38(19):1509-1516 (Discussion, citing van Hagen 2015 ROPAC)

effects.text: ENTIS experts list multiple malformations including an underdeveloped nose, stippled bone ends, skeletal and finger or toe (digital) defects, with reduced growth and facial differences.
effects.quote: Multiple malformations including nasal hypoplasia, stippled epiphyses, skeletal and digital. Growth disruption. Facial dysmorphia.
effects.source_label: ENTIS consensus, Bluett-Duncan et al., Birth Defects Res 2025;117(9):e2497, Table 1 (acenocoumarol row; the cell also covers phenindione and warfarin)

absolute_risk.text: The French label states that, with vitamin K antagonists including Sintrom, a malformation syndrome has been described in about 4% to 7% of exposed pregnancies, and gives no comparison rate.
absolute_risk.quote: un syndrome malformatif a été décrit dans environ 4 % à 7 % des grossesses exposées le plus souvent entre 6 et 9 semaines d'aménorrhée.
absolute_risk.source_label: ANSM, Résumé des Caractéristiques du Produit, SINTROM 4 mg (acénocoumarol), section 4.6, updated 20/06/2025

before_after.text: The French Sintrom label says women of childbearing age must be told to use effective contraception during treatment and until 3 days after stopping, and to plan pregnancies to allow a safer alternative.
before_after.quote: de la nécessité d’utiliser une contraception efficace pendant le traitement et jusqu’à 3 jours après l’arrêt de celui-ci et d’anticiper un projet de grossesse afin de permettre le relais par une alternative thérapeutique plus sûre
before_after.source_label: ANSM, Résumé des Caractéristiques du Produit, SINTROM 4 mg (acénocoumarol), sections 4.4 and 4.6, updated 20/06/2025

other_effects.text: The French Sintrom label states that cerebral fetopathy, mainly central nervous system and eye anomalies, occurs in 1 to 2% of vitamin K antagonist exposures beyond 9 weeks of amenorrhoea.
other_effects.quote: une fœtopathie cérébrale survient dans 1 à 2 % des cas d’exposition au-delà de 9 semaines d'aménorrhée
other_effects.source_label: ANSM, Résumé des Caractéristiques du Produit, SINTROM 4 mg (acénocoumarol), section 4.6 (class passage on vitamin K antagonists), updated 20/06/2025

regulatory.text: ANSM's December 2018 letter announced that vitamin K antagonists, including acenocoumarol, are contraindicated in pregnancy, except for women with a mechanical heart valve at high thromboembolic risk whose potential benefits outweigh the risks.
regulatory.quote: l’utilisation des antivitamines K est désormais contre-indiquée au cours de la grossesse, sauf chez les femmes enceintes portant une valve cardiaque mécanique qui présentent un risque thromboembolique élevé
regulatory.source_label: ANSM, Lettre aux professionnels de santé, Traitement par antivitamines K (AVK) : nouvelles informations (COUMADINE, PREVISCAN, SINTROM, MINISINTROM), 1 December 2018

monitoring.text: If Sintrom is used in pregnancy or pregnancy is discovered on treatment, the French label requires specialised prenatal diagnosis by ultrasound, or even MRI, adapted to the period of exposure.
monitoring.quote: la patiente doit être pleinement informée des risques pour le fœtus et un diagnostic prénatal spécialisé (échographique voire IRM) adapté en fonction de la période d'exposition doit être instauré
monitoring.source_label: ANSM, Résumé des Caractéristiques du Produit, SINTROM 4 mg (acénocoumarol), section 4.6, updated 20/06/2025

evidence_base.text: A multicentre prospective ENTIS cohort (1988–2004) followed 226 acenocoumarol-exposed pregnancies among 666 vitamin K antagonist exposures and 1,094 unexposed controls; its abstract reports results for the class as a whole.
evidence_base.quote: we compared 666 pregnant women exposed to phenprocoumon (n = 280), acenocoumarol (n = 226), fluindione (n = 99), warfarin (n = 63) and phenindione (n = 2) to a non-exposed control group (n = 1,094)
evidence_base.source_label: Schaefer C et al., Vitamin K antagonists and pregnancy outcome. A multi-centre prospective study, Thromb Haemost 2006;95(6):949-57, PubMed abstract

entries.name: Acitretin

sources.label: ENTIS expert list of known human structural teratogens
sources.note: Acitretin is on the list of medicines that ENTIS experts identify as known human structural teratogens (Bluett-Duncan M et al. A Scoping Review of Human Teratogens and Their Impact on the Developing Brain. Birth Defects Res. 2025;117(9):e2497).

entries.exposure_why: It is taken as a medicine, and treatment is how a pregnancy meets it.

window.text: ANSM counts from treatment: a pregnancy that starts during acitretin treatment or within 3 years after stopping carries a very high risk of major malformations in the fetus.
window.quote: La survenue, en dépit des mesures contraceptives, d'une grossesse au cours d'un traitement par acitrétine ou dans les 3 ans qui suivent son arrêt, comporte un risque très élevé de malformations majeures chez le fœtus.
window.source_label: ANSM, SORIATANE 25 mg gélule, RCP section 4.6 (Base de données publique des médicaments)

dose.text: The US label states that the blood-level threshold for increased birth defects has not been established for acitretin in humans, and post-treatment contraception time cannot be calculated precisely.
dose.quote: Because this threshold has not been established for acitretin in humans and because elimination rates vary among patients, the duration of posttherapy contraception to achieve adequate elimination cannot be calculated precisely.
dose.source_label: US FDA label, Acitretin capsules (Sigmapharm), boxed CONTRAINDICATIONS AND WARNINGS, via openFDA

effects.text: The US label lists reported major fetal abnormalities with acitretin or etretinate, including meningomyelocele, meningoencephalocele, multiple synostoses, facial dysmorphia, and limb or digit defects (syndactyly, absent terminal phalanges, hip, ankle and forearm malformations).
effects.quote: Major human fetal abnormalities associated with acitretin and/or etretinate administration have been reported including meningomyelocele; meningoencephalocele; multiple synostoses; facial dysmorphia; syndactyly; absence of terminal phalanges; malformations of hip, ankle, and forearm
effects.source_label: US FDA label, Acitretin capsules (Sigmapharm), boxed CONTRAINDICATIONS AND WARNINGS, via openFDA

before_after.text: ANSM requires women who can become pregnant to use contraception from at least 1 month before acitretin, throughout treatment and for at least 3 years after stopping, even without periods.
before_after.quote: Une méthode de contraception doit être utilisée pendant au moins 1 mois avant le début du traitement, pendant toute la durée du traitement et pendant au moins 3 ans après l'arrêt du traitement par acitrétine, même en cas d’aménorrhée.
before_after.source_label: ANSM, SORIATANE 25 mg gélule (acitrétine), RCP section 4.4, Contraception (Base de données publique des médicaments)

paternal.text: The US label says acitretin in semen appears to pose little, if any, risk to a fetus during or after a man's treatment, but the no-effect limit for teratogenicity is unknown.
paternal.quote: although it appears that residual acitretin in seminal fluid poses little, if any, risk to a fetus while a male patient is taking the drug or after it is discontinued, the no-effect limit for teratogenicity is unknown
paternal.source_label: US FDA label, Acitretin capsules (Sigmapharm), boxed CONTRAINDICATIONS AND WARNINGS, Important Information for Males, via openFDA

other_effects.text: Beyond malformations, acitretin's French product information states that there is also an increased risk of miscarriage.
other_effects.quote: Il existe également une augmentation du risque d'avortement spontané.
other_effects.source_label: ANSM, SORIATANE 25 mg gélule (acitrétine), RCP section 4.6 Grossesse (Base de données publique des médicaments)

regulatory.text: France's product information strictly contraindicates acitretin in pregnant women and in women who can become pregnant unless every condition of the pregnancy prevention programme is met.
regulatory.quote: SORIATANE 25 mg, gélule est strictement contre-indiqué chez : - les femmes enceintes, - les femmes en âge de procréer, sauf si toutes les conditions du « Programme de prévention de la grossesse » sont remplies.
regulatory.source_label: ANSM, SORIATANE 25 mg gélule (acitrétine), RCP section 4.4, Effets tératogènes (Base de données publique des médicaments)

monitoring.text: If a woman becomes pregnant on acitretin, ANSM requires stopping treatment and referring her to a physician specialised or experienced in teratology for evaluation and advice.
monitoring.quote: En cas de grossesse chez une femme traitée par acitrétine, le traitement doit être interrompu et la patiente doit être orientée vers un médecin spécialisé ou expérimenté en tératologie pour évaluation et conseil.
monitoring.source_label: ANSM, SORIATANE 25 mg gélule (acitrétine), RCP section 4.4, Programme de prévention de la grossesse (Base de données publique des médicaments)

jurisdictions.France: Legal; a pregnancy warning message or pictogram is mandatory on every alcoholic beverage (arrêté of 2 October 2006).
jurisdictions.Japan: Classified by the Japanese government under the GHS. A substance so classified must carry GHS labelling and a safety data sheet under the Industrial Safety and Health Act and the PRTR Law; the classification itself does not ban the substance.

entries.name: Alitretinoin

sources.label: ENTIS expert list of known human structural teratogens
sources.note: Alitretinoin is on the list of medicines that ENTIS experts identify as known human structural teratogens (Bluett-Duncan M et al. A Scoping Review of Human Teratogens and Their Impact on the Developing Brain. Birth Defects Res. 2025;117(9):e2497).

entries.exposure_why: It is taken as a medicine, and treatment is how a pregnancy meets it.

window.text: ANSM counts from treatment: pregnancy during alitretinoin (Toctino) treatment or within the month after stopping carries a very high risk of very severe malformations.
window.quote: La survenue, en dépit des mesures contraceptives, d'une grossesse au cours d'un traitement par TOCTINO ou dans le mois qui suit son arrêt, comporte un risque très élevé de malformations très sévères et graves chez le fœtus.
window.source_label: ANSM, TOCTINO 30 mg capsule molle, RCP section 4.6 (Base de données publique des médicaments)

effects.text: EMA's harmonised leaflet text says oral alitretinoin can cause serious abnormalities of the baby's brain, face, ear, eye, heart, thymus and parathyroid glands, and makes miscarriage more likely.
effects.quote: it can cause serious abnormalities of the unborn baby’s brain, face, ear, eye, heart and certain glands (thymus gland and parathyroid gland). It also makes a miscarriage more likely.
effects.source_label: EMA, Retinoid Article 31 referral 2018, Annex III (package leaflet text for oral acitretin, alitretinoin and isotretinoin)

before_after.text: ANSM requires women who can become pregnant to use contraception from at least 1 month before alitretinoin, throughout treatment and for at least 1 month after stopping, even without periods.
before_after.quote: Une méthode de contraception doit être utilisée pendant au moins 1 mois avant le début du traitement, pendant toute la durée du traitement et pendant au moins 1 mois après l'arrêt du traitement par alitrétinoïne, même en cas d'aménorrhée.
before_after.source_label: ANSM, TOCTINO 30 mg capsule molle (alitrétinoïne), RCP section 4.4, Contraception (Base de données publique des médicaments)

paternal.text: ANSM says available data suggest that a woman's exposure through the semen of men taking alitretinoin is not high enough to be linked to its teratogenic effects.
paternal.quote: Les données disponibles suggèrent que le niveau d’exposition maternelle à partir du sperme de patients traités par TOCTINO n’est pas suffisant pour être associé aux effets tératogènes de TOCTINO.
paternal.source_label: ANSM, TOCTINO 30 mg capsule molle (alitrétinoïne), RCP section 4.4, Hommes (Base de données publique des médicaments)

other_effects.text: Canada's product monograph states that pregnancy during alitretinoin treatment or within one month after stopping carries a risk of malformation and an increased risk of spontaneous abortion.
other_effects.quote: Pregnancy occurring during treatment with HANZEMA and for one month after its discontinuation, carries the risk of fetal malformation and the increased risk of spontaneous abortion
other_effects.source_label: Health Canada product monograph, HANZEMA (alitretinoin capsules, Dr. Reddy's), Warnings and Precautions, Pregnancy

regulatory.text: France's product information strictly contraindicates alitretinoin in pregnant women and in women who can become pregnant unless every condition of the pregnancy prevention programme is met.
regulatory.quote: TOCTINO est strictement contre-indiqué chez : · les femmes enceintes · les femmes en âge de procréer, sauf si toutes les conditions du Programme de prévention de la grossesse sont remplies
regulatory.source_label: ANSM, TOCTINO 30 mg capsule molle (alitrétinoïne), RCP section 4.4, Effets tératogènes (Base de données publique des médicaments)

monitoring.text: If a woman becomes pregnant on alitretinoin, ANSM requires stopping treatment and referring her to a physician specialised or experienced in teratology for evaluation and advice.
monitoring.quote: En cas de grossesse chez une femme traitée par l’alitrétinoïne, le traitement doit être interrompu et la patiente doit être orientée vers un médecin spécialisé ou expérimenté en tératologie pour évaluation et conseil.
monitoring.source_label: ANSM, TOCTINO 30 mg capsule molle (alitrétinoïne), RCP section 4.4, Programme de prévention de la grossesse (Base de données publique des médicaments)

evidence_base.text: Manufacturers' pharmacovigilance data assessed by EU regulators in 2018 counted 17 oral alitretinoin pregnancy cases since marketing, 12 conceived during treatment and 4 more than one month after stopping treatment.
evidence_base.quote: Alitretinoin: 17 pregnancy cases (12 related to conception during treatment, 4 more than one month after stopping treatment);
evidence_base.source_label: EMA PRAC assessment report, Article 31 referral on retinoid-containing medicinal products, section 2.4.1 Teratogenic effects, oral retinoids

entries.exposure_why: It is taken as a medicine, and treatment is how a pregnancy meets it.

window.text: France's product information says human data on tretinoin in pregnancy are limited, but there is a high risk of severe fetal malformations, particularly when it is given in the first trimester.
window.quote: les données sur l'utilisation de la trétinoïne chez la femme enceinte sont limitées mais il existe un risque élevé de malformations sévères du fœtus, en particulier lorsque la trétinoïne est administrée au cours du premier trimestre de la grossesse
window.source_label: ANSM, VESANOID 10 mg capsule molle, RCP section 4.6 Grossesse (Base de données publique des médicaments), RCP updated 22/04/2025

dose.text: In animal studies, the US label reports external, soft tissue and skeletal alterations above 0.7, 2 and 7 mg/kg/day in mice, rats and hamsters respectively, and at 10 mg/kg/day in monkeys.
dose.quote: Gross external, soft tissue and skeletal alterations occurred at doses higher than 0.7 mg/kg/day in mice, 2 mg/kg/day in rats, 7 mg/kg/day in hamsters, and at a dose of 10 mg/kg/day, the only dose tested, in pigtail monkeys
dose.source_label: US FDA label, tretinoin capsules (Par Health USA), section 8.1 Pregnancy, Animal Data (openFDA)

effects.text: From human exposure to retinoids, the US label reports malformations of the central nervous system, musculoskeletal system, external ear, eye, thymus and great vessels, plus facial dysmorphia, cleft palate and parathyroid hormone deficiency.
effects.quote: Reported malformations include abnormalities of the central nervous system, musculoskeletal system, external ear, eye, thymus and great vessels; and facial dysmorphia, cleft palate, and parathyroid hormone deficiency.
effects.source_label: US FDA label, tretinoin capsules (Par Health USA), section 8.1 Human Data (openFDA)

absolute_risk.text: EMA's 2018 review reports retinoid embryopathy in up to 30% of fetuses exposed to oral retinoids as a class, and it gives no rate specific to tretinoin.
absolute_risk.quote: The human data on congenital malformations after oral retinoid exposure show a significant risk of retinoid embryopathy (of up to 30% of fetuses exposed)
absolute_risk.source_label: EMA, retinoid Article 31 referral (EMEA/H/A-31/1446), Annex II scientific conclusions (EC decision 21 June 2018; Annex II first published 2 July 2018)

before_after.text: For women who could become pregnant, the US label requires a negative pregnancy test before starting and says to advise two effective contraceptive methods during treatment and for 1 month after the last dose.
before_after.quote: Females of reproductive potential must have a negative pregnancy test before initiating tretinoin capsules. Advise females of reproductive potential to use two effective methods of contraception during treatment with tretinoin capsules and for 1 month after the last dose.
before_after.source_label: US FDA label, tretinoin capsules (Par Health USA), boxed warning, via openFDA (DailyMed SPL version 20)

paternal.text: The US label says men taking oral tretinoin whose female partners could become pregnant should be advised to use effective contraception during treatment and for 1 week after the last dose.
paternal.quote: Advise males with female partners of reproductive potential to use effective contraception during and after treatment with tretinoin capsules and for 1 week after the last dose.
paternal.source_label: US FDA label, tretinoin capsules (Par Health USA), section 8.3 Use in Females and Males of Reproductive Potential, via openFDA (DailyMed SPL version 20)

other_effects.text: The US label says exposure to retinoids, the class tretinoin belongs to, in human pregnancy increases the risk of spontaneous abortion and premature birth as well as major malformations.
other_effects.quote: Tretinoin capsules are a retinoid and there is an increased risk of major congenital malformations, spontaneous abortions and premature births following exposure to retinoids during pregnancy in humans.
other_effects.source_label: US FDA label, tretinoin capsules (Par Health USA), section 8.1 Pregnancy, Risk Summary, via openFDA (DailyMed SPL version 20)

regulatory.text: Health Canada's product monograph places tretinoin's teratogenicity in its serious-warnings box and contraindicates its use in pregnant women.
regulatory.quote: Teratogenic effect: Tretinoin is highly teratogenic. Its use is contraindicated in pregnant women.
regulatory.source_label: Health Canada, VESANOID (tretinoin) 10 mg capsules product monograph (Cheplapharm), section 3 Serious Warnings and Precautions Box

monitoring.text: If Vesanoid is given in early pregnancy, the French product information says the patient must be told of the risk of teratogenic effects and of severe fetal malformations.
monitoring.quote: Si Vesanoid est administré en début de grossesse, la patiente doit être avertie du risque d'effets tératogènes de Vesanoid et du risque de malformations fœtales sévères.
monitoring.source_label: ANSM, VESANOID 10 mg capsule molle, RCP section 4.6 Grossesse (Base de données publique des médicaments)

evidence_base.text: A 2020 systematic review of 66 articles, 53 of them single case reports, found 92 pregnant women with APL eligible for induction, about three-quarters treated with all-trans retinoic acid alone or with chemotherapy.
evidence_base.quote: Sixty-six articles met the eligibility criteria (53 single case reports). Ninety-two patients were eligible for induction therapy, with most them being treated with all-trans retinoic acid alone (32%) or combined with chemotherapy (43%)
evidence_base.source_label: Santolaria A, Perales A, Montesinos P, Sanz MA. Acute promyelocytic leukemia during pregnancy: a systematic review of the literature. Cancers (Basel) 2020;12(4):968, abstract

regulatory.text: The boxed warning on US tobramycin injection labeling states that aminoglycosides can cause fetal harm when administered to a pregnant woman.
regulatory.quote: Aminoglycosides can cause fetal harm when administered to a pregnant woman
regulatory.source_label: US FDA label, tobramycin for injection (Northstar Rx), Boxed Warning

window.text: A CDC systematic review suggests streptomycin-related hearing deficits may also relate to exposures that began in the first trimester during prolonged treatment.
window.quote: The deficits identified may also be related to more pregnancies exposed to streptomycin beginning in the first trimester because of the longitudinal nature of the treatment.
window.source_label: Yu PA et al. Safety of Antimicrobials During Pregnancy: A Systematic Review of Antimicrobials Considered for Treatment and Postexposure Prophylaxis of Plague. Clin Infect Dis 2020;70(Suppl 1):S37-S50

dose.text: EMA tobramycin inhalation product information says aminoglycosides can cause fetal harm such as congenital deafness when high systemic concentrations are reached, and systemic exposure after inhalation is very low.
dose.quote: aminoglycosides can cause foetal harm (e.g. congenital deafness) when high systemic concentrations are achieved in a pregnant woman. Systemic exposure following inhalation of TOBI Podhaler is very low
dose.source_label: EMA, TOBI Podhaler (tobramycin inhalation powder) SmPC section 4.6

effects.text: US aminoglycoside labeling reports several cases of total irreversible bilateral congenital deafness in children whose mothers received streptomycin during pregnancy.
effects.quote: Aminoglycoside antibiotics cross the placenta, and there have been several reports of total irreversible bilateral congenital deafness in children whose mothers received streptomycin during pregnancy.
effects.source_label: US FDA label, tobramycin for injection (Northstar Rx), Precautions: Pregnancy Category D

other_effects.text: French tobramycin product information advises against use in pregnancy because of a potential risk of fetal ototoxicity and nephrotoxicity, and restricts use to serious infections.
other_effects.quote: L'utilisation de ce médicament est déconseillée au cours de la grossesse en raison d'un risque potentiel d'ototoxicité et de néphrotoxicité fœtales. Son utilisation sera strictement limitée aux pathologies infectieuses graves.
other_effects.source_label: ANSM, NEBCINE 100 mg solution injectable (tobramycin), RCP section 4.6

absolute_risk.text: A CDC systematic review reports hearing or vestibular deficits in 18 of 121 children (15%) after prenatal streptomycin exposure, pooled from 2 cohort studies and 2 case series, with no unexposed comparison group given.
absolute_risk.quote: Combined data from 121 prenatal streptomycin exposures in 2 cohort studies and 2 case series evaluated ototoxicity in children; 18/121 (15%) of children had either hearing or vestibular deficits based on audiogram and caloric testing
absolute_risk.source_label: Yu PA et al. Clin Infect Dis 2020;70(Suppl 1):S37-S50 (CDC systematic review)

monitoring.text: French tobramycin product information recommends assessing the newborn's hearing (otoacoustic emissions) and kidney function after exposure during pregnancy.
monitoring.quote: Dans le cas d'une exposition à ce médicament en cours de grossesse, une évaluation de la fonction auditive (autoémissions) et rénale du nouveau-né est recommandée.
monitoring.source_label: ANSM, NEBCINE 100 mg solution injectable (tobramycin), RCP section 4.6

evidence_base.text: A CDC systematic review of published studies and case reports counted 9 prenatal exposures to amikacin, 345 to gentamicin, 285 to streptomycin and 43 to tobramycin.
evidence_base.quote: totaling 27 751 prenatal exposures to amikacin (n = 9), gentamicin (n = 345), plazomicin (n = 0), streptomycin (n = 285), tobramycin (n = 43)
evidence_base.source_label: Yu PA et al. Clin Infect Dis 2020;70(Suppl 1):S37-S50 (CDC systematic review, PROSPERO CRD42018095490)

other_effects.source_label: Bluett-Duncan et al., ConcePTION scoping review with ENTIS expert-panel list of teratogens, Birth Defects Res 2025;117(9):e2497, Table 1 (row 'Methotrexate and Aminopterin')

evidence_base.text: A scoping review using the ENTIS expert list found 7 case series or reports and no empirical cohort on neurodevelopment after methotrexate or aminopterin, which it counts together.
evidence_base.quote: Structural teratogens included in this review and the number of case series/reports and empirical cohorts identified.
evidence_base.source_label: Bluett-Duncan et al., ConcePTION scoping review with ENTIS expert-panel list of teratogens, Birth Defects Res 2025;117(9):e2497, Table 1 caption; row 'Methotrexate and Aminopterin' gives 7 case series/reports and 0 empirical cohorts

papers.title: Developmental toxicity of thyroid-active compounds in a zebrafish embryotoxicity test

entries.exposure_why: It is taken as a medicine, and treatment is how a pregnancy meets it.

regulatory.text: Ireland's approved label contraindicates amiodarone during pregnancy, except in exceptional circumstances, because of its effect on the fetal thyroid gland.
regulatory.quote: In view of its effect on the foetal thyroid gland, amiodarone is contraindicated during pregnancy, except in exceptional circumstances.
regulatory.source_label: HPRA (Ireland) SmPC, Cordarone X 200mg Tablets, section 4.6

window.text: France's ANSM says the fetal thyroid starts taking up iodine from 14 weeks counted from the last menstrual period, so no fetal thyroid effect is expected from earlier administration.
window.quote: La thyroïde fœtale commençant à fixer l'iode à partir de 14 semaines d'aménorrhée, aucun retentissement sur la thyroïde fœtale n'est attendu en cas d'administrations préalables.
window.source_label: ANSM (France) RCP, Cordarone 200 mg comprimé sécable, section 4.6

dose.text: In animal studies, amiodarone given to rabbits, rats and mice during organogenesis caused embryo-fetal toxicity at doses below the maximum recommended human maintenance dose.
dose.quote: administration of amiodarone to rabbits, rats, and mice during organogenesis resulted in embryo-fetal toxicity at doses less than the maximum recommended human maintenance dose
dose.source_label: US FDA label (openFDA), amiodarone hydrochloride tablets, section 8.1

effects.text: France's ANSM states that clinical data are not currently relevant enough to assess a possible malformation risk when amiodarone is given in the first trimester.
effects.quote: En clinique, il n'existe pas actuellement de données suffisamment pertinentes pour évaluer un éventuel effet malformatif de l'amiodarone lorsqu'elle est administrée au premier trimestre de la grossesse.
effects.source_label: ANSM (France) RCP, Cordarone 200 mg comprimé sécable, section 4.6

other_effects.text: The US label says amiodarone use in pregnancy may increase the risk of neonatal hypo- and hyperthyroidism, neonatal bradycardia, neurodevelopmental abnormalities, preterm birth and fetal growth restriction.
other_effects.quote: amiodarone use in pregnant women may increase the risk for fetal adverse effects including neonatal hypo- and hyperthyroidism, neonatal bradycardia, neurodevelopmental abnormalities, preterm birth and fetal growth restriction
other_effects.source_label: US FDA label (openFDA), amiodarone hydrochloride tablets, section 8.1

absolute_risk.text: In a 2026 meta-analysis of seven single-arm case series of fetuses given amiodarone-inclusive treatment for tachyarrhythmia, the pooled incidence of thyroid dysfunction was 21.2%, with no comparison group.
absolute_risk.quote: The pooled incidence of thyroid dysfunction was 21.2% (95% CI:11.4%–32.6%).
absolute_risk.source_label: Kong L et al., Front Pharmacol 2026;17:1912369, systematic review and meta-analysis (PROSPERO CRD42024560291)

before_after.text: Ireland's label says that if stopping amiodarone before a planned conception is considered, given its long half-life, the real risk of recurrent life-threatening arrhythmia should be weighed against the unknown fetal hazard.
before_after.quote: because of the long half life of Cordarone X, discontinuation of the drug is considered prior to planned conception, the real risk of recurrence of life threatening arrhythmias should be weighed against the unknown possible hazard for the foetus
before_after.source_label: HPRA (Ireland) SmPC, Cordarone X 200mg Tablets, section 4.6

monitoring.text: The US label says to monitor the newborn for signs and symptoms of thyroid disorder and cardiac arrhythmias after amiodarone exposure in pregnancy.
monitoring.quote: Monitor the newborn for signs and symptoms of thyroid disorder and cardiac arrhythmias.
monitoring.source_label: US FDA label (openFDA), amiodarone hydrochloride tablets, section 8.1

evidence_base.text: A 2026 systematic review of amiodarone for fetal tachyarrhythmia analysed 107 treated pregnancies from 27 studies, which included case reports and case series.
evidence_base.quote: We analyzed 107 pregnancies treated with amiodarone from 27 studies.
evidence_base.source_label: Kong L et al., Front Pharmacol 2026;17:1912369, systematic review and meta-analysis (PROSPERO CRD42024560291)

regulatory.text: French product information advises against ACE inhibitors in the first trimester and contraindicates them in the second and third trimesters of pregnancy.
regulatory.quote: L'utilisation d'IEC est déconseillée pendant le 1er trimestre de la grossesse (voir rubrique 4.4). L'utilisation des IEC est contre-indiquée aux 2ème et 3ème trimestres de la grossesse
regulatory.source_label: ANSM, RENITEC 20 mg (enalapril) summary of product characteristics, section 4.6

window.text: US labels state that use in the second and third trimesters of pregnancy reduces fetal kidney function and increases fetal and newborn illness and death.
window.quote: Use of drugs that act on the renin-angiotensin system during the second and third trimesters of pregnancy reduces fetal renal function and increases fetal and neonatal morbidity and death.
window.source_label: Zestril (lisinopril) US prescribing information, sections 5.1 and 8.1 (effective 2025-01-02), via openFDA

effects.text: French enalapril product information says oligohydramnios, probably reflecting reduced fetal kidney function, can lead to limb contractures, craniofacial deformations and lung hypoplasia.
effects.quote: Des cas d'oligohydramnios maternel, représentant vraisemblablement la fonction rénale fœtale diminuée, peuvent survenir et entraîner des contractures des membres, des déformations cranio-faciales et le développement d'une hypoplasie pulmonaire.
effects.source_label: ANSM, RENITEC 20 mg (enalapril) summary of product characteristics, section 4.6

other_effects.text: The US lisinopril label says the resulting oligohydramnios can be linked to fetal lung hypoplasia and skeletal deformations, and newborns may have skull hypoplasia, anuria, low blood pressure, kidney failure or die.
other_effects.quote: Resulting oligohydramnios can be associated with fetal lung hypoplasia and skeletal deformations. Potential neonatal adverse effects include skull hypoplasia, anuria, hypotension, renal failure, and death.
other_effects.source_label: Zestril (lisinopril) US prescribing information, section 5.1 (effective 2025-01-02), via openFDA

absolute_risk.text: In a US Medicaid cohort, 5.9% of pregnancies exposed in the first trimester had a malformation versus 3.3% unexposed; among women with chronic hypertension, no significant increase remained after adjustment.
absolute_risk.quote: The prevalence of overall malformations in the ACE inhibitor-exposed pregnancies was 5.9% compared with 3.3% in the unexposed (unadjusted relative risk, 1.82; 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.61-2.06)
absolute_risk.source_label: Bateman et al., Obstet Gynecol 2017 (US Medicaid cohort, 1,333,624 pregnancies), PMID 27926639

before_after.text: Unless ACE-inhibitor treatment is considered essential, French product information recommends switching women who plan a pregnancy to an antihypertensive with an established safety profile in pregnancy, and stopping ACE inhibitors immediately once pregnancy is diagnosed.
before_after.quote: A moins que le traitement IEC soit considéré comme essentiel, il est recommandé de modifier le traitement antihypertenseur chez les patientes qui envisagent une grossesse pour un médicament ayant un profil de sécurité établi pendant la grossesse. En cas de diagnostic de grossesse, le traitement par IEC doit être arrêté immédiatement et si nécessaire un traitement alternatif sera débuté.
before_after.source_label: ANSM, RENITEC 20 mg (enalapril) summary of product characteristics, section 4.6

monitoring.text: French product information recommends a fetal ultrasound to check kidney function and the skull vault if exposure occurred from the second trimester onward, and close blood-pressure monitoring of exposed newborns.
monitoring.quote: En cas d'exposition à partir du 2ème trimestre de la grossesse, il est recommandé de faire une échographie fœtale afin de vérifier la fonction rénale et les os de la voûte du crâne. Les nouveau-nés de mères traitées par IEC doivent être étroitement surveillés sur le plan tensionnel.
monitoring.source_label: ANSM, RENITEC 20 mg (enalapril) summary of product characteristics, section 4.6

evidence_base.text: A US Medicaid claims cohort included 4,107 pregnancies exposed to ACE inhibitors in the first trimester among 1,333,624 pregnancies.
evidence_base.quote: The cohort included 1,333,624 pregnancies, of which 4,107 (0.31%) were exposed to ACE inhibitors during the first trimester.
evidence_base.source_label: Bateman et al., Obstet Gynecol 2017 (US Medicaid cohort), PMID 27926639

regulatory.text: The US label contraindicates azathioprine for rheumatoid arthritis in pregnant women and says use in pregnancy should be avoided whenever possible, after careful weighing of risk and benefit.
regulatory.quote: IMURAN should not be given during pregnancy without careful weighing of risk versus benefit. Whenever possible, use of IMURAN in pregnant patients should be avoided. This drug should not be used for treating rheumatoid arthritis in pregnant women.
regulatory.source_label: US FDA label, Imuran (Sebela), Contraindications and Warnings (effective 2025-11-08), via openFDA

window.text: ANSM says a newborn whose mother took azathioprine at the end of pregnancy may have anaemia, leukopenia, lymphopenia and/or thrombocytopenia.
window.quote: Un nouveau-né de mère traitée par l'azathioprine en fin de grossesse peut présenter une anémie, une leucopénie, une lymphopénie et/ou une thrombopénie.
window.source_label: ANSM, Imurel 50 mg comprimé pelliculé, RCP section 4.6 (updated 21/11/2025)

dose.text: ANSM says these newborn blood-count abnormalities are dose-dependent and usually transient, and that lowering the maternal dose when possible is desirable to prevent them.
dose.quote: Ces anomalies sont dose-dépendantes et habituellement transitoires. Afin d'éviter l'apparition de ces effets, une diminution de la posologie maternelle, lorsque cela est possible, est souhaitable
dose.source_label: ANSM, Imurel 50 mg comprimé pelliculé, RCP section 4.6 (updated 21/11/2025)

effects.text: A Swedish register study found an association between azathioprine exposure in early pregnancy and ventricular or atrial septal defects (adjusted OR 3.18, 95% CI 1.45-6.04).
effects.quote: An association between early pregnancy AZA exposure and ventricular/atrial septal defects was found (adjusted OR: 3.18, 95% CI: 1.45-6.04).
effects.source_label: Cleary and Källén, Birth Defects Res A 2009, Swedish Medical Birth Register, 476 exposed women (abstract)

other_effects.text: Health Canada says azathioprine can harm the fetus, including intra-uterine growth retardation, premature birth and low birth weight, particularly when combined with corticosteroids.
other_effects.quote: IMURAN can cause fetal harm when administered to a pregnant woman, including intra-uterine growth retardation, premature birth and low birth weight, particularly in combination with corticosteroids.
other_effects.source_label: Health Canada, Imuran product monograph, section 7.1.1 Pregnancy (authorized 2026-09-09)

absolute_risk.text: In a French nationwide registry of mothers with IBD, major malformations occurred in 197.2 per 10,000 births exposed to thiopurines in the first trimester versus 175.2 per 10,000 unexposed births.
absolute_risk.quote: The overall prevalence of MCMs ranged from 175.2 per 10,000 among unexposed births to 197.2 per 10,000 among those exposed to thiopurine
absolute_risk.source_label: Meyer et al., Clin Gastroenterol Hepatol 2025, EPI-MERES French nationwide registry of mothers with IBD (abstract)

before_after.text: The Jayempi (azathioprine) SmPC, authorised centrally in the EU, says male and female patients of reproductive age must use contraception during treatment and for at least six months after it ends.
before_after.quote: contraceptive measures must be taken by both male and female patients of reproductive age during azathioprine therapy for at least six months after the end of azathioprine therapy.
before_after.source_label: EMA, Jayempi (azathioprine) SmPC, section 4.4 (product information updated 23/04/2026)

paternal.text: A 2023 meta-analysis of men with IBD found paternal thiopurine use was not associated with early pregnancy loss, preterm birth or congenital malformations (OR 1.07).
paternal.quote: Thiopurine use was not associated with risk of EPL (OR, 1.31; I2 = 19%; P = .17), PB (OR, 1.05; I2 = 0%; P = .20), or CM (OR, 1.07; I2 = 7%; P = .34).
paternal.source_label: Gubatan et al., Clin Gastroenterol Hepatol 2023, systematic review and meta-analysis of paternal IBD medications (abstract)

monitoring.text: ANSM says the exposed newborn should have a full blood count, and live attenuated vaccines should be deferred until after 6 months of age as a precaution.
monitoring.quote: Une numération formule sanguine sera réalisée chez le nouveau-né. Le risque d'immunodépression néonatale conduit, par mesure de prudence, à différer l'administration de vaccins atténués vivants après 6 mois de vie.
monitoring.source_label: ANSM, Imurel 50 mg comprimé pelliculé, RCP section 4.6 (updated 21/11/2025)

evidence_base.text: The largest study read, a French nationwide registry, compared 5,223 births exposed to thiopurines in the first trimester with 28,827 unexposed births to mothers with IBD.
evidence_base.quote: Among a total of 39,515 births (5223 exposed to thiopurines, 6528 to anti-TNF, and 28,827 unexposed)
evidence_base.source_label: Meyer et al., Clin Gastroenterol Hepatol 2025, EPI-MERES French nationwide registry of mothers with IBD (abstract)

entries.name: Bexarotene

sources.label: ENTIS expert list of known human structural teratogens
sources.note: Bexarotene is on the list of medicines that ENTIS experts identify as known human structural teratogens (Bluett-Duncan M et al. A Scoping Review of Human Teratogens and Their Impact on the Developing Brain. Birth Defects Res. 2025;117(9):e2497).

entries.exposure_why: It is taken as a medicine, and treatment is how a pregnancy meets it.

window.text: The US label reports malformations in rats given bexarotene by mouth on gestation days 7 to 17, and it states no human risk window.
window.quote: Bexarotene caused malformations when administered orally to pregnant rats during days 7-17 of gestation.
window.source_label: US FDA label, TARGRETIN (bexarotene) capsules, Bausch Health, section 8.1 Pregnancy, Animal Data (openFDA)

dose.text: EMA states that a safety margin for human teratogenicity has not been demonstrated for bexarotene, based on its comparison of animal and patient exposures.
dose.quote: Based on the comparison of animal and patient exposures to bexarotene, a margin of safety for human teratogenicity has not been demonstrated
dose.source_label: EMA, Targretin EPAR product information, SmPC section 4.6

effects.text: For oral retinoids as a group, ENTIS lists multiple malformations, including central nervous system, orofacial cleft, cardiovascular, skeletal, limb and ear defects, as well as facial dysmorphia.
effects.quote: Multiple malformations including central nervous system abnormalities, orofacial clefts, cardiovascular, skeletal, limb and ear. Facial dysmorphia.
effects.source_label: Bluett-Duncan et al., Birth Defects Res 2025;117(9):e2497, Table 1 (ENTIS / ConcePTION); the effects cell spans all five oral retinoids

absolute_risk.text: EMA's 2018 review reports retinoid embryopathy in up to 30% of fetuses exposed to oral retinoids as a class, and it gives no rate specific to bexarotene.
absolute_risk.quote: The human data on congenital malformations after oral retinoid exposure show a significant risk of retinoid embryopathy (of up to 30% of fetuses exposed)
absolute_risk.source_label: EMA, retinoid Article 31 referral (EMEA/H/A-31/1446), Annex II scientific conclusions (EC decision 21 June 2018; Annex II first published 2 July 2018)

before_after.text: The US label requires effective contraception from 1 month before starting bexarotene, throughout treatment and for at least 1 month after stopping it.
before_after.quote: Effective contraception must be used for 1 month prior to the initiation of therapy, during therapy and for at least 1 month following discontinuation of therapy
before_after.source_label: US FDA label, TARGRETIN (bexarotene) capsules, Bausch Health, section 8.3 Females and Males of Reproductive Potential, via openFDA (DailyMed SPL version 16)

paternal.text: The EU product information says men taking bexarotene whose partners are, may be or could become pregnant must use condoms during intercourse throughout treatment and for at least one month after the last dose.
paternal.quote: Male patients with sexual partners who are pregnant, possibly pregnant, or may potentially become pregnant must use condoms during sexual intercourse while taking bexarotene and for at least one month after the last dose.
paternal.source_label: EMA, Targretin EPAR product information, SmPC section 4.6 Contraception in males and females

other_effects.text: In animal studies only, bexarotene given by mouth to pregnant rats at more than 10 mg/kg/day caused developmental mortality.
other_effects.quote: At doses greater than 10 mg/kg/day, bexarotene caused developmental mortality.
other_effects.source_label: US FDA label, TARGRETIN (bexarotene) capsules, Bausch Health, section 8.1 Pregnancy, Animal Data, via openFDA (DailyMed SPL version 16)

regulatory.text: The EU product information contraindicates bexarotene in pregnancy and breastfeeding, and in women of child-bearing potential who do not use effective contraception.
regulatory.quote: Pregnancy and lactation. Women of child-bearing potential without effective birth-control measures.
regulatory.source_label: EMA, Targretin EPAR product information, SmPC section 4.3 Contraindications

monitoring.text: If pregnancy occurs during treatment, the US label says to stop bexarotene immediately and to advise the woman of the potential risk to the fetus.
monitoring.quote: If pregnancy does occur during treatment with TARGRETIN, immediately discontinue the drug and advise the pregnant female of the potential risk to a fetus.
monitoring.source_label: US FDA label, TARGRETIN (bexarotene) capsules, Bausch Health, section 8.1 Pregnancy, Risk Summary, via openFDA (DailyMed SPL version 16)

evidence_base.text: EMA's product information for the oral capsules says there are no adequate data on bexarotene use in pregnant women and that animal studies have shown reproductive toxicity.
evidence_base.quote: There are no adequate data from the use of bexarotene in pregnant women. Studies in animals have shown reproductive toxicity.
evidence_base.source_label: EMA, Targretin (oral capsules) EPAR product information, SmPC section 4.6 Pregnancy

entries.exposure_why: It is taken as a medicine, and treatment is how a pregnancy meets it (WHO ATC N03AF01).

dose.text: In EURAP, major malformations rose with the dose taken at conception, from 4.6% at 700 mg a day or less to 5.9% above 700 up to 1,000 mg and 9.1% above 1,000 mg.
dose.source_label: Battino et al. (EURAP), JAMA Neurol 2024;81(5):481-489, Table 2 (CC-BY)

effects.text: The French product information lists neural tube defects (spina bifida), craniofacial defects including cleft lip or palate, cardiovascular malformations, hypospadias, finger hypoplasia and microcephaly among the most frequent malformations.
effects.quote: Les malformations les plus souvent rencontrées sont des anomalies du tube neural (spina bifida), des anomalies crânio-faciales (dont les fentes labiales/palatines), des malformations cardiovasculaires, des hypospadias, une hypoplasie des doigts, une microcéphalie
effects.source_label: ANSM, Tegretol 200 mg comprimé sécable, RCP section 4.6 (base de données publique des médicaments, page last updated 29/09/2026)

absolute_risk.text: In the US label, the North American registry found major malformations in 3.0% of 1,033 first-trimester exposures to carbamazepine alone, a relative risk of 2.7 (95% CI 1.0 to 7.0) versus no antiepileptic drug.
absolute_risk.quote: major congenital malformations of 3.0% [...] among pregnant females exposed to carbamazepine monotherapy (n=1,033) during the first trimester with a relative risk of 2.7 (95% CI: 1.0, 7.0) compared to pregnant females not taking an epileptic drug
absolute_risk.source_label: US label, Equetro (carbamazepine), Validus, section 8.1 Pregnancy (Human Data, NAAED Pregnancy Registry), via openFDA

before_after.text: French product information says a pregnancy test should be considered before starting, and effective contraception is needed during treatment and until two weeks after stopping, as hormonal contraceptives may fail.
before_after.quote: Les femmes susceptibles de procréer doivent utiliser une contraception efficace pendant le traitement et jusqu’à deux semaines après l’arrêt du traitement.
before_after.source_label: ANSM, Tegretol 200 mg comprimé sécable, RCP sections 4.4 and 4.6 (base de données publique des médicaments)

other_effects.text: French product information says a Nordic registry study suggests more small-for-gestational-age births (12.8% versus 10.9% for children of untreated women with epilepsy), and that neurodevelopmental studies are contradictory and cannot exclude a risk.
other_effects.quote: Le risque de PAG chez les enfants de femmes épileptiques traitées par carbamazépine était de 12,8 %, contre 10,9 % chez les enfants de femmes épileptiques ne recevant pas de traitement antiépileptique.
other_effects.source_label: ANSM, Tegretol 200 mg comprimé sécable, RCP section 4.6 (base de données publique des médicaments)

regulatory.text: Since 2025 in France, girls, women who could become pregnant and pregnant women must show the pharmacist, with the prescription, an information form co-signed yearly with their doctor to obtain carbamazepine.
regulatory.quote: Pour dispenser ce médicament à une fille, une adolescente, une femme susceptible d’avoir des enfants ou enceinte, la patiente doit vous présenter, en plus de l’ordonnance, l’attestation d’information partagée signée chaque année par elle et le médecin.
regulatory.source_label: ANSM news, 'Carbamazépine et grossesse : renforcement de l'information des femmes', information for pharmacists (published 13/12/2024, updated 27/03/2025)

monitoring.text: French product information recommends specialised prenatal monitoring for malformations and growth restriction, folic acid before and during pregnancy and, if treatment continues, monotherapy at the lowest effective dose with plasma-level monitoring.
monitoring.quote: Une surveillance prénatale spécialisée de ces malformations et du retard de croissance est recommandée.
monitoring.source_label: ANSM, Tegretol 200 mg comprimé sécable, RCP section 4.6 (base de données publique des médicaments)

evidence_base.text: A 2023 Cochrane systematic review pooled 5,415 carbamazepine-exposed children from 37 cohort studies and 2,806 from five health-record studies, all observational, finding major malformations in 4.7% and 4.0%.
evidence_base.quote: The prevalence of major malformations (any type) in the cohort studies for children exposed to carbamazepine (CBZ) (N = 5415), based on data from 37 studies, was 4.7% (95% CI 3.7 to 5.9).
evidence_base.source_label: Bromley et al., Monotherapy treatment of epilepsy in pregnancy: congenital malformation outcomes in the child, Cochrane Database Syst Rev 2023, Results (carbamazepine)

entries.name: Carbimazole

sources.label: ENTIS expert list of known human structural teratogens
sources.note: Carbimazole is on the list of medicines that ENTIS experts identify as known human structural teratogens (Bluett-Duncan M et al. A Scoping Review of Human Teratogens and Their Impact on the Developing Brain. Birth Defects Res. 2025;117(9):e2497).

entries.exposure_why: It is taken as a medicine, and treatment is how a pregnancy meets it.

window.text: EU product information says carbimazole is suspected to cause malformations when used in pregnancy, particularly in the first trimester; it counts by trimester and gives no week range.
window.quote: Based on human experience from epidemiological studies and spontaneous reporting, carbimazole is suspected to cause congenital malformations when administered during pregnancy, particularly in the first trimester of pregnancy and at high doses.
window.source_label: EMA PRAC, New product information wording, carbimazole SmPC 4.6 (EPITT 19238), adopted 26-29 November 2018

dose.text: The UK medicines regulator says carbimazole is associated with an increased malformation risk, particularly at high doses, which it defines as 15 mg or more daily.
dose.quote: carbimazole is associated with an increased risk of congenital malformations when used during pregnancy, particularly in the first trimester of pregnancy and at high doses (15 mg or more of carbimazole daily)
dose.source_label: MHRA Drug Safety Update, volume 12, issue 7, February 2019 (carbimazole: increased risk of congenital malformations)
dose.id: MHRA Drug Safety Update vol 12 issue 7

effects.text: EU product information reports malformations including a missing patch of skin (aplasia cutis), choanal atresia, facial dysmorphism, exomphalos, oesophageal atresia, omphalomesenteric duct anomaly and ventricular septal defect, naming no limb defects.
effects.quote: Reported malformations include aplasia cutis congenita, craniofacial malformations (choanal atresia; facial dysmorphism), exomphalos, oesophageal atresia, omphalo-mesenteric duct anomaly, and ventricular septal defect.
effects.source_label: EMA PRAC, New product information wording, carbimazole SmPC 4.6 (EPITT 19238)

absolute_risk.text: In a Danish nationwide register, 9.6% of children exposed to methimazole or carbimazole in early pregnancy had a birth defect diagnosed before age 2, versus 6.7% of unexposed children.
absolute_risk.quote: The overall frequency of birth defects was 6.7% (95% CI, 6.7% to 6.8%) in nonexposed children and higher after exposure to methimazole/carbimazole (9.6%; 95% CI, 8.2% to 11.2%)
absolute_risk.source_label: Andersen SL et al. Maternal thyroid function, use of antithyroid drugs in early pregnancy, and birth defects. J Clin Endocrinol Metab 2019;104(12):6040-6048 (abstract)

before_after.text: EU product information tells women who could become pregnant to use reliable contraception from the start of carbimazole treatment and during it, and sets no period after stopping.
before_after.quote: If you could get pregnant, use reliable contraception from the time you start treatment and during treatment.
before_after.source_label: EMA PRAC, New product information wording, carbimazole package leaflet section 2 (EPITT 19238), adopted 26-29 November 2018

other_effects.text: New Zealand product information says transient thyroid function abnormalities have been reported in newborns whose mothers took carbimazole (Neo-Mercazole) during pregnancy.
other_effects.quote: Transient thyroid function abnormalities have been reported in new-borns born to mothers treated with Neo-Mercazole during pregnancy.
other_effects.source_label: Medsafe (New Zealand regulator), Neo-Mercazole (carbimazole) New Zealand Data Sheet, section 4.6, revised 10 December 2020

regulatory.text: Under the 2018 EU wording, carbimazole may be given in pregnancy only after a strict individual benefit-risk assessment, at the lowest effective dose and without added thyroid hormones.
regulatory.quote: Carbimazole must only be administered during pregnancy after a strict individual benefit/risk assessment and only at the lowest effective dose without additional administration of thyroid hormones.
regulatory.source_label: EMA PRAC, New product information wording, carbimazole SmPC 4.6 (EPITT 19238), adopted 26-29 November 2018

monitoring.text: New Zealand product information says a prenatal ultrasound should be considered to detect some of the malformations it lists and to monitor the fetal thyroid, and a neonatal thyroid function test should be performed.
monitoring.quote: A prenatal exam (ultrasound) should be considered in order to detect some of the above-cited malformations and to monitor the foetal thyroid gland. A neonatal thyroid function test should be performed.
monitoring.source_label: Medsafe (New Zealand regulator), Neo-Mercazole (carbimazole) New Zealand Data Sheet, section 4.6, revised 10 December 2020

evidence_base.text: A 2022 systematic review and meta-analysis of 16 cohort studies counted 5,957 pregnancy exposures to carbimazole or methimazole, analysed together rather than drug by drug.
evidence_base.quote: We identified 16 cohort studies comprising 5957, 15,785, and 15,666 exposures to CMZ/MMI, PTU, and untreated hyperthyroidism, respectively.
evidence_base.source_label: Agrawal M et al. Antithyroid drug therapy in pregnancy and risk of congenital anomalies: systematic review and meta-analysis. Clin Endocrinol (Oxf) 2022;96(6):857-868 (abstract)

regulatory.text: French product information contraindicates cyclophosphamide in pregnancy and in women of childbearing age who do not use effective contraception.
regulatory.quote: Par conséquent, le cyclophosphamide est contre-indiqué chez la femme enceinte et chez les femmes en âge de procréer n’utilisant pas de contraception efficace.
regulatory.source_label: ANSM, ENDOXAN 1000 mg RCP sections 4.3 and 4.6, Base de données publique des médicaments (page updated 29/09/2026)

window.text: The US label reports malformations of the skeleton, palate, limbs and eyes, and miscarriage, after cyclophosphamide exposure in the first trimester.
window.quote: Malformations of the skeleton, palate, limbs and eyes as well as miscarriage have been reported after exposure to cyclophosphamide in the first trimester.
window.source_label: US FDA label, Cyclophosphamide for Injection (Baxter, ANDA040745), section 8.1 Human Data, via openFDA

dose.text: Animal data in the US label show cyclophosphamide given to pregnant mice, rats, rabbits and monkeys at doses at or below the human dose caused malformations, including limb and digit defects.
dose.quote: Administration of cyclophosphamide to pregnant mice, rats, rabbits and monkeys during the period of organogenesis at doses at or below the dose in patients based on body surface area resulted in various malformations
dose.source_label: US FDA label, Cyclophosphamide for Injection (Baxter, ANDA040745), section 8.1 Animal Data, via openFDA

effects.text: French product information describes a fairly consistent malformation pattern including limb anomalies, eye defects, craniosynostosis, facial dysmorphism, hydrocephalus and microcephaly.
effects.quote: En clinique, des cas de malformations avec un tableau malformatif assez homogène (anomalies de membres, atteintes de l’œil, craniosténoses, dysmorphies faciales, atteintes du système nerveux central à type d’hydrocéphalie et microcéphalie)
effects.source_label: ANSM, ENDOXAN 1000 mg RCP sections 4.3 and 4.6, Base de données publique des médicaments (page updated 29/09/2026)

other_effects.text: The US label reports fetal growth retardation and newborn toxicity, including leukopenia, anemia, pancytopenia, severe bone marrow hypoplasia and gastroenteritis, after cyclophosphamide exposure.
other_effects.quote: Fetal growth retardation and toxic effects manifesting in the newborn, including leukopenia, anemia, pancytopenia, severe bone marrow hypoplasia, and gastroenteritis have been reported after exposure to cyclophosphamide.
other_effects.source_label: US FDA label, Cyclophosphamide for Injection (Baxter, ANDA040745), section 8.1 Human Data, via openFDA

absolute_risk.text: The final 2013 NTP systematic review found an apparent major malformation rate of 18% (7/40) after first-trimester cyclophosphamide exposure in published cases, against 3% in the US general population.
absolute_risk.quote: the apparent rate of major malformations following exposure to cyclophosphamide during the first trimester was 18% (7/40 conceptuses, based on 36 liveborn infants and examination of the fetuses of 2 stillbirths and 2 induced abortions)
absolute_risk.source_label: US National Toxicology Program (NIEHS), NTP Monograph on Developmental Effects and Pregnancy Outcomes Associated with Cancer Chemotherapy Use During Pregnancy, section 5.11 (final monograph, supersedes the prepublication copy)

before_after.text: The US label asks prescribers to verify pregnancy status before starting and advises women to use effective contraception during treatment and for up to 1 year afterwards.
before_after.quote: Advise females of reproductive potential to use effective contraception during treatment with Cyclophosphamide for Injection and for up to 1 year after completion of therapy.
before_after.source_label: US FDA label, Cyclophosphamide for Injection (Baxter, ANDA040745), section 8.3, via openFDA

paternal.text: The US label advises men with partners who could become pregnant to use effective contraception during treatment and for 4 months after it ends, based on genotoxicity and animal data.
paternal.quote: Based on findings in genetic toxicity and animal reproduction studies, advise male patients with female partners of reproductive potential to use effective contraception during treatment with Cyclophosphamide for Injection and for 4 months after completion of therapy
paternal.source_label: US FDA label, Cyclophosphamide for Injection (Baxter, ANDA040745), section 8.3, via openFDA

monitoring.text: If the pregnancy continues, French product information requires specialised prenatal screening targeted at cyclophosphamide malformations and neonatal monitoring, especially haematological and cardiac.
monitoring.quote: En cas de poursuite de la grossesse, un dépistage prénatal spécialisé, ciblé sur les malformations décrites avec le cyclophosphamide est nécessaire ; ainsi qu’une surveillance néonatale (en particulier hématologique et cardiaque).
monitoring.source_label: ANSM, ENDOXAN 1000 mg RCP sections 4.3 and 4.6, Base de données publique des médicaments (page updated 29/09/2026)

evidence_base.text: The final 2013 NTP systematic review documents 416 cyclophosphamide-exposed pregnancies from published reports in cancer patients, 413 cases given as polytherapy and only 6 as monotherapy.
evidence_base.quote: A total of 416 pregnancies and 419 conceptuses were exposed to cyclophosphamide on account of 3 sets of twins
evidence_base.source_label: US National Toxicology Program (NIEHS), NTP Monograph on Developmental Effects and Pregnancy Outcomes Associated with Cancer Chemotherapy Use During Pregnancy, section 5.11 (final monograph, supersedes the prepublication copy)

regulatory.text: French product information contraindicates cyclophosphamide in pregnancy and in women of childbearing age who do not use effective contraception.
regulatory.quote: Par conséquent, le cyclophosphamide est contre-indiqué chez la femme enceinte et chez les femmes en âge de procréer n’utilisant pas de contraception efficace.
regulatory.source_label: ANSM, ENDOXAN 1000 mg RCP sections 4.3 and 4.6, Base de données publique des médicaments (page updated 29/09/2026)

window.text: The US label reports malformations of the skeleton, palate, limbs and eyes, and miscarriage, after cyclophosphamide exposure in the first trimester.
window.quote: Malformations of the skeleton, palate, limbs and eyes as well as miscarriage have been reported after exposure to cyclophosphamide in the first trimester.
window.source_label: US FDA label, Cyclophosphamide for Injection (Baxter, ANDA040745), section 8.1 Human Data, via openFDA

dose.text: Animal data in the US label show cyclophosphamide given to pregnant mice, rats, rabbits and monkeys at doses at or below the human dose caused malformations, including limb and digit defects.
dose.quote: Administration of cyclophosphamide to pregnant mice, rats, rabbits and monkeys during the period of organogenesis at doses at or below the dose in patients based on body surface area resulted in various malformations
dose.source_label: US FDA label, Cyclophosphamide for Injection (Baxter, ANDA040745), section 8.1 Animal Data, via openFDA

effects.text: French product information describes a fairly consistent malformation pattern including limb anomalies, eye defects, craniosynostosis, facial dysmorphism, hydrocephalus and microcephaly.
effects.quote: En clinique, des cas de malformations avec un tableau malformatif assez homogène (anomalies de membres, atteintes de l’œil, craniosténoses, dysmorphies faciales, atteintes du système nerveux central à type d’hydrocéphalie et microcéphalie)
effects.source_label: ANSM, ENDOXAN 1000 mg RCP sections 4.3 and 4.6, Base de données publique des médicaments (page updated 29/09/2026)

other_effects.text: The US label reports fetal growth retardation and newborn toxicity, including leukopenia, anemia, pancytopenia, severe bone marrow hypoplasia and gastroenteritis, after cyclophosphamide exposure.
other_effects.quote: Fetal growth retardation and toxic effects manifesting in the newborn, including leukopenia, anemia, pancytopenia, severe bone marrow hypoplasia, and gastroenteritis have been reported after exposure to cyclophosphamide.
other_effects.source_label: US FDA label, Cyclophosphamide for Injection (Baxter, ANDA040745), section 8.1 Human Data, via openFDA

absolute_risk.text: The final 2013 NTP systematic review found an apparent major malformation rate of 18% (7/40) after first-trimester cyclophosphamide exposure in published cases, against 3% in the US general population.
absolute_risk.quote: the apparent rate of major malformations following exposure to cyclophosphamide during the first trimester was 18% (7/40 conceptuses, based on 36 liveborn infants and examination of the fetuses of 2 stillbirths and 2 induced abortions)
absolute_risk.source_label: US National Toxicology Program (NIEHS), NTP Monograph on Developmental Effects and Pregnancy Outcomes Associated with Cancer Chemotherapy Use During Pregnancy, section 5.11 (final monograph, supersedes the prepublication copy)

before_after.text: The US label asks prescribers to verify pregnancy status before starting and advises women to use effective contraception during treatment and for up to 1 year afterwards.
before_after.quote: Advise females of reproductive potential to use effective contraception during treatment with Cyclophosphamide for Injection and for up to 1 year after completion of therapy.
before_after.source_label: US FDA label, Cyclophosphamide for Injection (Baxter, ANDA040745), section 8.3, via openFDA

paternal.text: The US label advises men with partners who could become pregnant to use effective contraception during treatment and for 4 months after it ends, based on genotoxicity and animal data.
paternal.quote: Based on findings in genetic toxicity and animal reproduction studies, advise male patients with female partners of reproductive potential to use effective contraception during treatment with Cyclophosphamide for Injection and for 4 months after completion of therapy
paternal.source_label: US FDA label, Cyclophosphamide for Injection (Baxter, ANDA040745), section 8.3, via openFDA

monitoring.text: If the pregnancy continues, French product information requires specialised prenatal screening targeted at cyclophosphamide malformations and neonatal monitoring, especially haematological and cardiac.
monitoring.quote: En cas de poursuite de la grossesse, un dépistage prénatal spécialisé, ciblé sur les malformations décrites avec le cyclophosphamide est nécessaire ; ainsi qu’une surveillance néonatale (en particulier hématologique et cardiaque).
monitoring.source_label: ANSM, ENDOXAN 1000 mg RCP sections 4.3 and 4.6, Base de données publique des médicaments (page updated 29/09/2026)

evidence_base.text: The final 2013 NTP systematic review documents 416 cyclophosphamide-exposed pregnancies from published reports in cancer patients, 413 cases given as polytherapy and only 6 as monotherapy.
evidence_base.quote: A total of 416 pregnancies and 419 conceptuses were exposed to cyclophosphamide on account of 3 sets of twins
evidence_base.source_label: US National Toxicology Program (NIEHS), NTP Monograph on Developmental Effects and Pregnancy Outcomes Associated with Cancer Chemotherapy Use During Pregnancy, section 5.11 (final monograph, supersedes the prepublication copy)

regulatory.text: The US label carries a boxed warning that danazol is contraindicated in pregnancy and recommends a sensitive pregnancy test immediately before starting therapy.
regulatory.quote: Use of danazol in pregnancy is contraindicated. A sensitive test (e.g., beta subunit test if available) capable of determining early pregnancy is recommended immediately prior to start of therapy.
regulatory.source_label: US label, Danazol capsules, Chartwell RX, boxed warning, via openFDA

window.text: France's ANSM, counting weeks of amenorrhoea, says described cases of female fetal virilisation followed exposure most often from the end of week 8 of amenorrhoea and prolonged treatment.
window.quote: des cas de virilisation du foetus féminin sont décrits pour des expositions intra-utérines le plus souvent à partir de la fin de la 8e semaine d'aménorrhée et pour une durée de traitement prolongée.
window.source_label: ANSM, Danatrol 200 mg gélule, RCP section 4.6 (Fertilité, grossesse et allaitement)

effects.text: The US label says danazol in the womb may cause androgenic effects in a female fetus, with reports of clitoral enlargement, fused labia, urogenital sinus defect, vaginal atresia and ambiguous genitalia.
effects.quote: Exposure to danazol in utero may result in androgenic effects on the female fetus; reports of clitoral hypertrophy, labial fusion, urogenital sinus defect, vaginal atresia, and ambiguous genitalia have been received
effects.source_label: US label, Danazol capsules, Chartwell RX, boxed warning, via openFDA

other_effects.text: In rabbits (animal data), danazol given on gestation days 6 to 18 at 60 mg/kg/day and above, 2 to 4 times the human dose, inhibited fetal development.
other_effects.quote: In rabbits, the administration of danazol on days 6-18 of gestation at doses of 60 mg/kg/day and above (2-4 times the human dose) resulted in inhibition of fetal development.
other_effects.source_label: US label, Danazol capsules, Chartwell RX, Precautions (Pregnancy, Teratogenic Effects), via openFDA

before_after.text: Health Canada says that, after danazol for fibrocystic breast disease, it may be prudent to continue non-hormonal contraception until a period of normal flow and duration has occurred.
before_after.quote: It may be prudent to continue non-hormonal contraception after danazol treatment for fibrocystic breast disease until a menstrual period that is normal in amount of flow and duration has occurred.
before_after.source_label: Health Canada product monograph, Cyclomen (danazol), sanofi-aventis Canada, Precautions

monitoring.text: France's ANSM recommends ultrasound monitoring focused on the fetus's external genitalia after accidental exposure to danazol during pregnancy.
monitoring.quote: En cas d'exposition fortuite en cours de grossesse, une surveillance échographique orientée sur les organes génitaux externes est recommandée.
monitoring.source_label: ANSM, Danatrol 200 mg gélule, RCP section 4.6 (Fertilité, grossesse et allaitement)

evidence_base.text: Health Canada says danazol was not teratogenic in rats, rabbits or rhesus monkeys (animal studies).
evidence_base.quote: In the 3 species used danazol was not teratogenic. No consistent syndrome of anatomic alterations was found which could be defined as teratogenic. Of particular significance was the lack of any teratogenic effect in the rhesus monkey.
evidence_base.source_label: Health Canada product monograph, Cyclomen (danazol), sanofi-aventis Canada, Toxicology (Reproduction Studies)

regulatory.text: French ANSM minocycline product information contraindicates cyclines from the second trimester and, as a precaution, prefers that they not be used in the first trimester.

window.text: FDA tetracycline-class labeling places the tooth discoloration risk during tooth development, defined as the last half of pregnancy, infancy and childhood to the age of 8 years.
window.quote: The use of drugs of the tetracycline-class during tooth development (last half of pregnancy, infancy and childhood to the age of 8 years) may cause permanent discoloration of the teeth (yellow-gray-brown).
window.source_label: US FDA label, tetracycline hydrochloride capsules (Amneal), Warnings: Tooth Development

dose.text: FDA tetracycline-class labeling says tooth discoloration is more common with long-term use but has also been seen after repeated short-term courses.
dose.quote: This adverse reaction is more common during long-term use of the drugs but it has been observed following repeated short-term courses.
dose.source_label: US FDA label, tetracycline hydrochloride capsules (Amneal), Warnings: Tooth Development

effects.text: FDA minocycline labeling mentions rare spontaneous postmarketing reports of congenital anomalies including limb reduction, and says limited information allows no conclusion on a causal association.
effects.quote: Rare spontaneous reports of congenital anomalies including limb reduction have been reported in postmarketing experience. Only limited information is available regarding these reports; therefore, no conclusion on causal association can be established.
effects.source_label: US FDA label, minocycline hydrochloride (Northwind Health), Pregnancy: Risk Summary

other_effects.text: FDA labeling says tetracycline-class drugs, including minocycline, may cause permanent discoloration of deciduous teeth and reversible inhibition of bone growth when given in the second and third trimesters.
other_effects.quote: Tetracycline class drugs, including minocycline hydrochloride extended-release tablets may cause permanent discoloration of deciduous teeth and reversible inhibition of bone growth when administered during the second and third trimesters of pregnancy
other_effects.source_label: US FDA label, minocycline hydrochloride extended-release tablets (PD-Rx), 8.1 Pregnancy

absolute_risk.text: In a Swedish national cohort, major malformations occurred in 39.75 per 1000 infants exposed to tetracyclines in the first trimester versus 38.76 per 1000 propensity-matched unexposed infants.
absolute_risk.quote: The prevalence of any MCMs among tetracycline-exposed infants was 39.75 cases per 1000 infants (95% CI, 35.14-44.93 cases per 1000 infants; 252 infants) and that among unexposed infants was 38.76 cases per 1000 infants
absolute_risk.source_label: Nakitanda AO et al. First Trimester Tetracycline Exposure and Risk of Major Congenital Malformations. JAMA Netw Open 2024;7(11):e2445055

monitoring.text: FDA minocycline extended-release labeling says to advise a patient who becomes pregnant during treatment of the risk to the fetus and to discontinue treatment.
monitoring.quote: If a patient becomes pregnant while taking this drug, advise the patient of the risk to the fetus and to discontinue treatment.
monitoring.source_label: US FDA label, minocycline hydrochloride extended-release tablets (PD-Rx), 8.1 Pregnancy

evidence_base.text: A Swedish nationwide cohort, described by its authors as substantially larger than previous reports rather than as the largest, included 6340 first-trimester-exposed infants: 4962 exposed to doxycycline, 1199 to lymecycline, 180 to tetracycline and 13 to oxytetracycline.
evidence_base.quote: Among the 6340 exposed infants (3325 male [52.4%]), 4962 (78.3%) were exposed to doxycycline, 1199 (18.9%) to lymecycline, 180 (2.8%) to tetracycline, and 13 (0.2%) to oxytetracycline.
evidence_base.source_label: Nakitanda AO et al. JAMA Netw Open 2024;7(11):e2445055 (Swedish nationwide register cohort)
